note: Caldwell Parish (22021) has no public queryable parcel service I could find. The assessor's parcel map is a vendor viewer (actDataScout) that returned HTTP 403 from a WAF and exposes no service URL. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches found no Caldwell parcel FeatureServer. The LandGrid Louisiana parcel service requires a token. Regrid is commercial and its nationwide map service is not queryable.
